leads.name: Thuy Ha banyan, Dong Anh
leads.reason: VACNE-recognised, about 233 years, girth 6.2 m at ground, 20 m high, Thuy Ha village, Bac Hong commune (press snippet via search, page not fetched). Roughly 20 km north of centre, over 30 minutes by public transport; no coordinate.

leads.name: Khe Tang banyans (two), Cu Khe, Thanh Oai
leads.reason: VACNE recognition 21 Jan 2024, 'nearly 400 years', about 20 km west of centre (vacne.org.vn e4140). Day trip beyond 30 minutes, no coordinate, no girth, communal-house-yard not stated.

leads.name: Hang Pagoda Da and Sanh, Thanh My, Son Tay
leads.reason: VACNE recognition 13 Aug 2020, both over 300 years, Vi Thuy village, Son Tay town (vacne.org.vn e3673). Over 40 km from centre; no coordinate.

leads.name: Bach Tuyet banyan, My Duc
leads.reason: VACNE certificate Nov 2013, about 300 years, communal house of Bach Tuyet hamlet, Hung Tien commune, My Duc (VietNamNet 19 Nov 2013). About 40 km out; no coordinate.

leads.name: Son Tay Den Va ironwood forest
leads.reason: 85 trees recognised by VACNE in a forest (search snippet, not fetched): a wood, not one spot. Blocked as an avenue/wood.

leads.name: Banyan at 71 Hang Trong (Nhan Dan newspaper HQ)
leads.reason: Over 300 years, dozens of people to encircle it (Nhan Dan 23 Feb 2022 and 10 Mar 2026, VietNamNet 2023), in the courtyard of a newspaper's headquarters: not open to visitors as far as found, no register recognition seen. Blocked unless a source shows public access.

leads.name: Ba Kieu temple banyan, Dinh Tien Hoang
leads.reason: Beside Ba Kieu temple facing Hoan Kiem lake; no age figure, the rear banyan was uprooted by Typhoon Yagi 2024 and replanted (Tien Phong, search summary). Condition needs rechecking before any use.

leads.name: Uncle Ho banyan, Thong Nhat park
leads.reason: Planted 11 Jan 1960 by Ho Chi Minh (Nhan Dan 23 Feb 2022): one source only, young (about 66 years), no coordinate. Historic, not old.

leads.name: Van Mieu bodhi by the triple gate
leads.reason: 'Possibly about a century' judged from the roots by the Van Mieu management board, said to be the largest bodhi in Hanoi (VnExpress 22 Apr 2016): single source, estimate, no measurement, no coordinate. Worth a second source; the Temple of Literature itself has no recognised heritage tree found.

leads.name: Bodhi trees at One Pillar Pagoda and Tran Phu (OSM nodes)
leads.reason: OSM tree nodes 'Cay bo de' (11959830446, 21.03596,105.83329), another at 21.03602,105.83370 and 'Cay De' at 21.03245,105.83247 on Tran Phu. One Pillar bodhi tied by VnExpress to a Prasad gift Feb 1958 but the article does not clearly link the marker to this tree. No age, no size.

leads.name: Heritage trees of Tay Ho palace (OSM)
leads.reason: Two OSM nodes named 'Heritage Tree Of Tay Ho Temple' (10945738908 with check_date 2026-09-11 and species tag; 10945738912 at 21.05644,105.81971), website tag points to VACNE. No source found naming the recognition, age or measurements; a lead for a pass that can read the plaque or the VACNE record.

leads.name: Quan La communal house banyan, Xuan La
leads.reason: Claimed 1000 years old and visited by Ho Chi Minh in 1958 (search summary only; page not fetched). Unverified: no recognition confirmed.
